focuses.desc:
Norway has fallen. Reichskommissariat Norwegen (RKG) is ruled from Oslo by a German official, Josef Terboven - or, if Berlin chose to use a local puppet, by Vidkun Quisling of the Nasjonal Samling (vanilla event wuw_GER_reichskommissariats.3). Norway is 'Germanic': in Nazi theory its people are to be won for a Greater Germanic Reich, not removed. But its coast is a fortress, its waterfalls power the Reich's aluminium and heavy water, and its people mostly hate the occupation.

THE TREE (draft): like the Generalgouvernement it forms early (1940-41) and must last to the German civil war and beyond - about 11 years. Four eras (to build as 'available' gates):
1. THE OCCUPATION (from creation).
2. THE WAR IN THE EAST (Germany at war with the Soviet Union, or the Soviet Union gone): the Arctic front, Kirkenes, the convoys.
3. AFTER THE VICTORY (the Soviet Union gone): the Germanic Reich, Nordstern.
4. AFTER THE REICH (the German civil war has begun): Donitz's German Administrative Government forms in DOVER (built 2026-11-25), not Oslo - Oslo stays ours - and Narvik comes to us instead of to Dover.

NARVIK (built, 2026-11-25): when the Reichskommissariat forms, Germany keeps Nordland (144, Narvik) - the ore port and the U-boat base. When the Reich falls apart, Narvik goes to the Reichskommissariat, not to Donitz's German Administrative Government - which now sits in Dover, so the Reichskommissariat also keeps Oslo.

10 STATES: Oslofjord (110, capital - kept even when the Reich falls), Vestlandet (142, Bergen), Trondelag (143), Opplandene (920), Telemark (921, Rjukan), Agder (922), Helgeland (923), Troms (924), Finnmark (925); Nordland (144) only after the Reich falls.

NO LOYAL SEPARATION (user, 2026-11-25): a Reichskommissar knows how fragile his position is without German backing. The ONE break-off is QUISLING'S COUP - only if the Reich did NOT choose Quisling (the Terboven path) and only after the Reich has fallen apart: Quisling turns the Norwegian fascists against the Reichskommissar and proclaims an independent Norwegian National State - still fascist, still racist. It stays open to Swedish attack (the future Swedish tree, a friend's work), and once the Ostschild war is over a reunited Germany gets a decision: reinvade Norway, or leave it (BUILT 2026-11-25, waiting for the flag wif_rkg_quisling_state). A democratic Norway can only come from outside, through Sweden.

CORING: only Quisling's independent Norwegian National State (the coup) cores Norway - all of it. A loyal Reichskommissariat never cores; without the coup it returns to the Reich at reunification like every other RK.

THE RESISTANCE (proposal): Milorg and Kompani Linge - sabotage, not open war: a meter like the Forest Brothers' (start 15, floor 10) whose attacks hit factories, the aluminium works, the heavy water plant and shipping. Open question.
